close_reason:
Replaced chat_capability + chat_push_capability bodies with one-line delegation to account.account_extension_capability::<T>(URI). The 'account not found' early-return is preserved in this crate because the foundation helper is &self on AccountInfo, not (Session, account_id).

ChatCapability and ChatPushCapability already implement DeserializeOwned via #[derive(Deserialize)] over owned fields, so the generic T: DeserializeOwned bound is satisfied automatically.

All 10 capability-related lib tests still pass (the public contract is unchanged). Total lib tests still 52, clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings clean, fmt clean.

This is the canonical cookie-cutter shape: every extension client's *_capability accessor should now look identical. The same finding likely applies to jmap-mail-client, jmap-calendars-client, jmap-contacts-client, jmap-tasks-client, jmap-filenode-client, jmap-sharing-client, jmap-metadata-client — a workspace-wide sweep bead is appropriate but out of scope for this review epic.

Committed as c626efa.
description: src/session.rs:179-213. The bodies of chat_capability() and chat_push_capability() duplicate the logic in jmap-base-client::AccountInfo::account_extension_capability<T> (request.rs:314): fetch account_capabilities[uri], T::deserialize(raw), map ClientError::Parse. AGENTS.md 'Canonical Templates' rule says 'change the canonical first, then propagate' — but here the canonical seam already exists in base-client and the extension crate ignores it. Future changes to the foundation helper (extra logging, error mapping, telemetry) will silently NOT propagate. Fix: replace each impl body with a one-liner delegating to account.account_extension_capability(uri). This also tightens the cookie-cutter shape: every extension client's chat_capability/calendar_capability/contacts_capability etc. should look identical.
title: session.rs duplicates AccountInfo::account_extension_capability instead of delegating
